name: domino-progress
title: Domino Progress
description: A deploy pipeline drawn as a line of standing dominoes. Each completed step tips the current tile onto the next, which wobbles from the hit and lights up as the active step. Pause opens a gap so the falling tile lands flat on the table, Resume slides the next tile in and the chain carries on to Live, and Reset ripples every tile back upright. Buttons, status text and a live region keep it usable without the animation.
